sources.title: All-Pedal Devil's Triad Essentials - Jeff Loomis Signature Pedal | Effects Database
sources.h1: All-Pedal Devil's Triad Essentials - Jeff Loomis Signature Pedal
sources.excerpt: Effects Database identifies Devil's Triad Essentials as a Jeff Loomis collaboration built from the Drive and Boost sections of the Devil's Triad.

sources.title: Versatile Drive + Dual Boost with 3-Band EQ Precision - All-Pedal
sources.excerpt: The manufacturer describes the pedal as a drive plus integrated Pre and Post Boost with an active three-band EQ. Specifications include analog op-amp drive and boost, measured drive input impedance of about 400K at 1kHz, total output of 20dB, boost from unity to 20dB, and 9VDC/37mA operation with no internal battery.

sources.title: All-Pedal and Jeff Loomis Unveil Devil's Triads Essentials Pedal - Premier Guitar
sources.h1: All-Pedal and Jeff Loomis Unveil Devil's Triads Essentials Pedal
sources.excerpt: Premier Guitar's May 25, 2024 report lists Level and Gain for Drive, Treble/Mids/Bass for EQ, Pre Boost and Post Boost, true bypass, and 9-volt operation.

next_action: Use the manufacturer page as the primary technical source and the Effects Database/Premier Guitar pages for model identity and corroboration. Do not infer undocumented clipping components.
